diagrams.title: Scalability Evolution

        C1[cmd/gdown/main.go]

        C3[pkg/engine/engine.go]
        C4[pkg/engine/progress.go]
        C5[pkg/engine/resume.go]

    subgraph Growth[Growth step: isolate hot components]

    end

diagrams.title: Sequence: CLI Download
diagrams.description: Critical workflow from CLI entrypoint through engine, resume, HTTP, and progress updates.
diagrams.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
    actor U as CLI User
    participant CLI as cmd/gdown/main.go
    participant ENG as pkg/engine/engine.go
    participant RES as pkg/engine/resume.go
    participant HTTP as pkg/util/http.go
    participant FS as Local Filesystem
    participant PROG as pkg/engine/progress.go

    U->>CLI: run download URL
    CLI->>ENG: runDownload(config)
    ENG->>RES: load resume metadata
    RES-->>ENG: prior offsets/state
    ENG->>HTTP: open ranged HTTP requests
    HTTP-->>ENG: response streams
    ENG->>FS: write chunks
    ENG->>PROG: update transfer progress
    PROG-->>CLI: progress snapshot
    CLI-->>U: render progress + completion
